name: PolyRelate Bridge (Mobile)
description: One-tap Paste Link for PolyRelate on Obsidian iOS/Android — inserts a captured Bookmark's link at the cursor and reports back so PolyRelate can record the relationship, mirroring the Mac app's Paste Link. Pairs with PolyRelateShare's "Send to Obsidian" action; does not replace the separate desktop-only PolyRelate Bridge plugin, which keeps handling Mac-side capture and previews.
author: Martin Lester
